craft_notes: Sthāyin: twelve occasions, one call. Rows: long catalogue kept whole. Rejected: trimming — killed: completeness is the doctrine. Read aloud: long roll, firm close.

lines: Wisdom won, scripture won, the master's house neared,
birth-days, world-feasts, doctrine told, first midst and last, gods met, conclave, dream-bid, dues cleared — this feastly calls for heightened praise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: naimittikam jñānalābhaḥ śāstralābho gurutadvargagṛhāgamanaṃ tadīyajanmasaṃskāraprāyaṇadināni laukikotsavaḥ śāstravyākhyā ādimadhyāntā devatādarśanaṃ melakaṃ svapnājñā samayaniṣkṛtilābhaḥ ity etat naimittikaṃ viśeṣārcanakāraṇam
